name: Weather

components.pose: She stands in the open as the weather of her homeland closes in, her clothing and hair lifting, one hand raised against it and her eyes narrowed and then turned to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Golden light and drifting motes are caught up in the weather and stream around her, {{MAGIC}} light flickering in it.

notes: REALM SERIES: Weather in her light homeland (weather); realistic, from realms/light-lands and backgrounds/fantasy/country/light.
